source_name: НАБУ (National Association of Banks of Ukraine) — member bank pages
why_relevant: Industry association member directory. Useful as an actor-map spine (canonical legal names, АТ prefixes, contacts) and for association-level news where bank executives take committee roles — a soft but real indicator of seniority and mandate changes.

source_name: YouControl / Opendatabot — company registry profiles for banks
why_relevant: Commercial wrappers over the state company register (ЄДР). Signatory/director changes are registered here, often before any announcement, and the change history is timestamped — the strongest independent dating layer for departures, which banks almost never press-release.

source_name: PaySpace Magazine (psm7.com) — UA fintech/payments trade media
why_relevant: The dedicated UA payments/fintech trade outlet; covers PSP/acquirer appointments, product and org changes, and runs the PSM Awards which itself is a people/company map of the market. Highest-density single feed for this cell.

source_name: Ekonomichna Pravda — finance section
why_relevant: Major business daily that covers payment-sector regulation, ownership and management stories at investigative depth (e.g. NBU fines on EasyPay/City24; completion of Concord bank liquidation, which feeds the 'Concord-successors' thread of this cell).

source_name: Liga.net Finance (finance.liga.net) — banking & fintech news
why_relevant: Directly published a CEO-appointment story for a licensed UA payment institution (NovaPay appointing a new general director), which is exactly the A5 signal type for this cell. Good coverage of non-bank payment providers.

source_name: NovaPay — corporate site (press/about/careers)
why_relevant: Largest licensed UA non-bank payment institution / money-transfer operator (NOVA group). Its own site carries management announcements, corporate-culture pages and a live vacancy list — a first-party feed for both leadership moves and hiring volume.

source_name: DOU.ua company & vacancy pages for UA payment companies (jobs.dou.ua)
why_relevant: The dominant UA tech job/community board; per-company pages (NovaPay, Fondy, PaySpaceMagazine and others) expose vacancy counts, headcount claims and role mix over time — the best proxy for hiring intensity and org build-out in payments, and often the earliest visible sign of a new function (e.g. a new acquiring or risk team).

source_name: Work.ua — employer pages for payment companies
why_relevant: Broader-than-IT UA job board; covers the non-engineering payment roles that DOU misses (agent network, cash-handling, retail terminal ops, compliance/AML, call centre) — the roles that reveal branch/terminal-network expansion for PSPs and money-transfer operators.

source_name: Opendatabot — state-register monitoring and open financial-licence lists
why_relevant: Open-data mirror of the state register of financial institutions/licences plus change-monitoring on registration data; a cheaper, API-friendly complement to YouControl for detecting new payment entities and management changes.

source_name: EMA Association (Ukrainian Interbank Association of Payment System Members) — members & partners lists
why_relevant: Industry body since 1999 whose membership spans payment systems, banks, financial companies, payment providers and MFOs. Its member/partner directory is the best non-regulatory actor map for this cell, and its events/working groups expose named executives by function (fraud, acquiring, e-com).

source_name: ThePage.ua — executive appointments and resignations coverage
why_relevant: Runs recurring round-ups explicitly devoted to the loudest top-manager appointments and resignations across Ukrainian business (observed: a 2025–2026 round-up), which is a ready-made periodic digest for the A5 leadership-moves topic including financial/payment names.

source_name: Business.diia.gov.ua entrepreneur handbook — institutional entries on payment-market bodies
why_relevant: State business portal that describes payment-market institutions and associations; a stable, government-hosted pointer layer for identifying the institutional actors and their official names/roles in the payment ecosystem.

source_name: UAPAY (Ukrainian National Payment Service) — corporate site
why_relevant: A licensed UA payment service provider whose site names its CEO publicly — a first-party leadership datapoint and a template for the per-company 'about/team' collection pattern that should be applied across every entity in the NBU register.

source_name: American Chamber of Commerce in Ukraine — Power Payment Summit and payments committee programmes
why_relevant: Event agendas list speakers with exact current job titles and employers across UA payment institutions, acquirers and regulators — one of the most reliable ways to observe who currently holds which seat, and to detect a title change between editions.

source_name: UKR.NET aggregator — per-source feeds for UA payment/fintech media
why_relevant: News aggregator with stable per-publisher feed pages; a resilient discovery/backfill layer when a publisher's own site is bot-defended or lacks RSS, and a way to catch smaller regional outlets reporting local PSP/terminal-operator hires.

source_name: Antikor / investigative aggregators — payment-operator schemes and management exposure
why_relevant: Reveals-indirectly source: investigative/compromat aggregators name the beneficial owners and managers behind terminal networks and PSPs (EasyPay/FC Kontraktovyi Dim, City24/Swift Guarantee) that never publish org information. Low credibility, high lead value — must be corroborated against the register.

source_name: ОГо! — Telegram channel of Oleh Horokhovskyi (monobank co-founder)
why_relevant: monobank's co-founder announces product launches, new verticals, team milestones and occasionally named hires/leads on his personal channel long before any corporate wire. Highest-velocity weak-signal channel for the cell.

source_name: Робота в monobank🤟 — official monobank jobs Telegram channel
why_relevant: Company-run hiring channel; volume and role-mix of postings is a direct proxy for team expansion and for new product verticals (a new 'Head of X' posting precedes an org change).

source_name: mono careers page (monobank.ua/careers)
why_relevant: Canonical employer-published vacancy list for mono / Fintech-IT Group products (monobank, monoбізнес, monomarket, Base, Experienza). Product-line names in job ads reveal the current org structure.

source_name: DOU jobs — company page 'mono'
why_relevant: DOU is the dominant Ukrainian tech job board; the mono company page gives structured, dated vacancies plus headcount and employee reviews — a clean time series for team expansion.

source_name: DOU лента — tag «вакансії» / hiring & layoff discussion feed
why_relevant: Editorial + community feed where fintech headcount changes, hiring freezes and notable departures get discussed before/without press releases.

source_name: robota.ua — mono company profile
why_relevant: Non-IT roles (call centre, collections, analysts, branch/ops) that never appear on DOU; scale of these postings tracks operational expansion of the neobank.

source_name: work.ua — Monobank | Universal Bank employer page
why_relevant: Second mass job board; postings are filed under the licensed legal entity (Universal Bank), which lets you separate bank-entity hiring from IT-company hiring.

source_name: Happy Monday — monobank employer profile
why_relevant: Employer-branding platform carrying culture/HR interviews with mono managers; useful for identifying who owns which function (names + titles) rather than raw vacancy counts.

source_name: Opendatabot — company monitoring (ТОВ монобанк and peer entities)
why_relevant: State-register (ЄДР) mirror with change monitoring: a director/signatory change on the legal entity is a hard, dated confirmation of a leadership move, independent of PR. Also reveals new subsidiaries = new verticals.

source_name: National Bank of Ukraine — bank supervision data / approval of bank managers (погодження керівників банків)
why_relevant: Regulator must approve chairs/board members of licensed banks; NBU publishes bank-manager information and supervisory data. This is the authoritative gate through which every neobank-partner bank's C-level change must pass.

source_name: Tascombank 'our team' page + neobank-partners page (izibank)
why_relevant: izibank runs on Tascombank's licence; the licensing bank's management page and its neobank-partners page are the authoritative record of who governs the izibank product and which neobank partnerships exist (sportbank was removed after Apr 2024 closure).
